proposed.title: Hawkeye#1
proposed.text: Clint takes Cooper and his siblings to New York for Christmas. They walk out of the musical together and spend the evening at dinner and the Rockefeller Center tree.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's eldest son, on a Christmas trip with him to New York.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Cooper's dad, who takes the kids to New York for Christmas.

their_evidence: Never Meet Your Heroes (Hawkeye ep 1): Clint, Cooper, Lila and Nathaniel attend Rogers: The Musical, leave midway, eat at a Chinese restaurant (Cooper picks ugly sweaters as his activity, thanks the waiter) and see the tree. Ep 2: Clint leaves Cooper in charge as the kids fly home; ep 6: Cooper greets him and helps carry in presents.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron

stages.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's wife, who keeps their family safe on the farm.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Laura's husband, away on missions while she keeps the family safe.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Clint loses Laura to the Snap on the family farm and is reunited with her five years later, when she calls him after the Blip.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's wife, lost to the Snap and found again five years later.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Laura's husband, who loses her to the Snap and gets her back five years later.

proposed.title: Hawkeye#4
proposed.text: Laura helps Clint from home while he stays in New York, tracking the signal of her old S.H.I.E.L.D. watch and sending him the address where it is hidden.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's wife, who tracks her stolen watch for him from home.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Laura's husband, who stays in New York to get her old watch back.

their_evidence: Partners, Am I Right? (ep 4): with Laura's help Clint recovers his sword, and Laura tells him the stolen watch is sending a tracking signal from an apartment building (3715 Godrey Road). Earlier calls in ep 1 and 2; ep 5 she tells him to end it; ep 6 he returns the watch to her on Christmas.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Clint teaches Lila archery on the farm, and she vanishes in the Snap moments after he praises her bullseye. They are reunited after the Blip.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's daughter and archery student, lost to the Snap and found after the Blip.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Lila's dad, who teaches her archery. She vanishes moments after his praise.

proposed.title: Hawkeye#1
proposed.text: On a Christmas trip to New York, Lila finds Clint outside the musical and hugs him, knowing it reminds him of Natasha. The family skips the rest of it together.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's daughter, who sees how much he misses Natasha.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Lila's dad, who struggles through a musical about the Avengers.

their_evidence: Never Meet Your Heroes (ep 1): Lila leaves the theater to find Clint, tells him it's fine not to watch since Natasha was his best friend, and hugs him. Ep 2: he promises her he'll be home for Christmas and tells her she is really in charge; ep 6: 'You made it. You kept your promise.'

their_evidence: Never Meet Your Heroes (ep 1): at dinner Clint tries to tell Laura the play was good but Nathaniel tells her they left halfway; Clint carries him into the hotel. Ep 2: Nathaniel signs 'I love you' to him; ep 3: Nathaniel calls him on Laura's phone.

their_evidence: Hide and Seek (ep 2): the kids fly home, Laura picks them up and they build gingerbread houses while she takes Clint's call. Ep 1 she calls the family at dinner; ep 4 she tells the kids Dad will be away longer; ep 6 Christmas together.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Lila accuses Cooper of taking her headphones, a squabble Clint overhears when a time travel test drops him back in the family farmhouse. Both vanish in the Snap and return after the Blip.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Lila's brother, who swears he never had her headphones.

their_evidence: Avengers: Endgame, Clint's quantum test trip to the old farmhouse: Lila: 'Cooper! Where. Are. My. Headphones?' Cooper: 'I never had them.' Cast list credits 'Cooper Barton / Time Heist Test (voice)' and 'Lila Barton / Time Heist Test'.

proposed.title: The Marvels
proposed.text: Aamir fights off the Kree who wreck the Khan home and is left with broken glasses and questions for his sister. When Kamala leaves on her mission, he tells her to come back safely.

their_evidence: The Marvels: Aamir hits a Kree soldier with a coat rack and gets his glasses broken, looks at Kamala in disappointment, asks Monica 'Where's my sister?', and says 'You better. I don't wanna be an only child' as she leaves; he hugs her when she returns.

proposed.title: The Marvels
proposed.text: Aamir leaps to help when a Kree soldier attacks Muneeba in their home. Later, when she hints that the Rambeau house would suit a family, he mutes her with a remote.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Aamir's mother, who hints it's time he raised a family.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Muneeba's son, who jumps in when the Kree attack her.

their_evidence: The Marvels: 'As Aamir saw a guard attack his mother, he leaped over the couch to help'; at the Rambeau Residence Muneeba says 'Aamir... this would be a lovely house to raise a family in', and he jokingly mutes her with a remote.

question: These two family pairs are at the same farm picnic and vanish in the same Snap and return in the same Blip, but never speak to or deal with each other directly. The existing Laura and Lila Endgame stage is 'vanish together in the Snap'. Add a matching stage for these pairs?
